findings.suggested_fix: Set `document.approved_by = current_user.id` and write an activity_log entry: `Approved document X by user Y at timestamp`.

findings.detail: No engagement lifecycle state machine detected. Invalid transitions (e.g. CLOSED -> ASSIGNED) may succeed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a `VALID_ENGAGEMENT_TRANSITIONS` dict and validate every PATCH /engagement against it.

findings.detail: No server-side entitlement check detected. Frontend-only gating is bypassable.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `Depends(require_entitlement('feature_name'))` to every route that produces premium content / actions.

findings.detail: Notification code lacks visible idempotency key. Worker restart may re-send duplicate deadline alerts.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a `notification_id` (uuid) per logical notification; check exists before insert.

findings.detail: Report service does not appear to bind to an evidence snapshot_id. Report content may be inconsistent with the snapshot displayed to the client.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist evidence snapshot at evaluation time; reference snapshot_id in the report.

findings.detail: Report service does not appear to record rule_engine_version. Same report URL may render different content over time as rule definitions change.
findings.suggested_fix: Stamp every report with engine_version + registry_hash; render the report against the rule definitions in force at evaluation time.
